01 · Plan your visit

Two sources disagree on weekday closing time.

Google Maps, checked 19 October 2026: Tuesday–Friday 09:00–15:00; Saturday–Sunday 09:00–20:00; Monday closed.

Google Maps ↗

The Ministry of Culture museum portal, checked on the same date: Tuesday–Friday 09:00–16:00; Saturday–Sunday 09:00–20:00; Monday closed. It lists public holidays as 09:00–16:00.

Ministry of Culture — museum profile ↗

The weekday one-hour difference is unresolved in the sources reviewed. Confirm last admission, gallery hours and holiday closures before travelling. A weekend 20:00 listing does not guarantee every room or performance operates into the evening.

Check your ticket category rather than one headline price.

Jakarta’s revenue agency report of 2 April 2026 mentions Rp5,000 for children and university students, Rp10,000–15,000 for adults and Rp50,000 for international visitors. The museum portal shows Rp10,000 on weekdays and Rp15,000 at weekends without visitor-group details in its table.

These are attributed references, not guaranteed totals or eligibility. Ask about student evidence, age, visit date, payment method, reservations and any extra room or programme conditions. Do not assume an old free-entry promotion still applies.

Jakarta revenue agency — ticket categories, 2 April 2026 ↗

02 · 2025

A renewed museum inaugurated on 24 January 2025.

A Jakarta government release dated 24 January 2025 describes the renewed Museum Wayang, puppet, mask and doll displays, and interactive and immersive experiences. This counters an outdated impression of indefinite renovation closure, but does not confirm every room, device or service is available today.

Jakarta government — renewed museum, 24 January 2025 ↗

03 · Collection

Explore the collection, then check the current programme.

The national portal identifies a specialised wayang museum managed by Unit Pengelola Museum Seni. The 2025 release describes puppets, masks and dolls in the displays. Follow curatorial labels and staff instructions; an item in an old photograph is not guaranteed to be on display now.

The culture department records a Wayang Orang Betawi performance on 29 March 2026. Although the archive title calls it “regular”, one dated event is not a guarantee of a show every Sunday, fixed times, included tickets or reservations today. Check an announcement for your visit date.

Culture department — event on 29 March 2026 ↗

04 · Access & facilities

Confirm the final route and facilities separately.

Transport

Check active routes, destination stations or stops, exits and the final approach with the operator. This guide guarantees no walking distance, journey time, airport route or step-free connection.

Accessibility & facilities

The 2025 renewal report describes interactive features. Ask about ramps, lifts, upper-floor access, wheelchairs, toilets, prayer space, assistance and sensory needs before travelling. Old accessibility descriptions are not assumed to remain valid.

Parking & practical needs

Confirm legal parking, charges and drop-off points. Check individual providers for food, ATMs, accommodation, fuel or vehicle charging; no availability or service hours are guaranteed at the museum.

Kota Tua museums and public spaces are separate destinations.

Check Taman Fatahillah, Jakarta History Museum and other Kota Tua destinations for their own addresses, access, hours and charges. Do not apply Museum Wayang tickets or hours to the square or assume a direct connecting path or combined admission.

05 · Open map

Use the museum name and confirm the entrance.

The museum is in the Jalan Pintu Besar Utara area, Pinangsia, Taman Sari, West Jakarta 11110. Maps also displays Jl. Kali Besar Timur 4 No. 27, RT 3/RW 6 wording. The checked pin is -6.1349287, 106.8123108. Different road labels do not establish that every side of the building is an entrance.

Questions before visiting

What are Wayang Museum’s opening hours?

Maps on 19 October 2026 lists Tuesday–Friday 09:00–15:00, while the Ministry of Culture portal lists 09:00–16:00. Both list Saturday–Sunday 09:00–20:00 and Monday closed. Confirm the weekday discrepancy, holidays and last admission before travelling.

Is the museum open every evening?

There is no basis to promise evening access every day. The 20:00 listing applies only to Saturday–Sunday in both checked sources. It does not confirm every gallery, show or ticket counter remains open until then.

How much are Wayang Museum tickets?

The revenue agency’s 2 April 2026 report mentions Rp5,000 children/university students, Rp10,000–15,000 adults and Rp50,000 international visitors. The museum portal lists Rp10,000 weekdays/Rp15,000 weekends without group details. Confirm eligibility, evidence and coverage for your visit date.

Is the museum still closed for renovation?

Jakarta’s government reports the renewed museum’s inauguration on 24 January 2025. Do not treat old renovation reports as permanent closure; check temporary closures and accessible rooms for your date.

Are puppet performances always available?

No show is guaranteed. Official archives record specific events, including 29 March 2026. Confirm the programme, date, reservations and any extra charge rather than assuming an old timetable repeats automatically.

What can visitors learn about?

The 2025 government release describes puppet, mask and doll displays with interactive elements. The accessible collection and rooms depend on the museum’s arrangements at the time.

Are wheelchair access and parking available?

Ask about the entrance, paths, floor access, assistance, toilets and parking actually operating before travelling. Old accessibility details are not a guarantee of current conditions.

Is this the official website or a ticket outlet?

No. This is an independent visitor guide without museum or government affiliation and provides no tickets, bookings or accounts. Confirm details with the operator and official channels.

Public sources and their limits

Checked 19 October 2026. Maps is a third-party snapshot; government prices and events have their own dates and categories. Photographs are archival and do not confirm access or available facilities.
